onSessionStart.description: Load LitFolio project context for new/resumed Snow sessions

hooks.command:
cat <<'EOF'
LitFolio project context:
- Stack: Tauri 2 desktop app with React 18 + TypeScript + Vite frontend and Rust 2021 backend.
- Common checks: pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test; for backend changes run cargo test from src-tauri when possible.
- IPC boundary: keep src/lib/api*.ts, src/lib/apiSchema*.ts, src/test/tauriMockCommands.ts, and src-tauri/src/commands/mod.rs aligned.
- Persistence changes require new migrations in src-tauri/migrations/ and matching storage/repository updates.
- Do not use page-level dangerouslySetInnerHTML; use src/components/MarkdownView.tsx.
- Release versions must stay in sync across package.json, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml, and src-tauri/Cargo.lock.
EOF
